player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} ({piece}) rai sai. Hpang de ahte Opponent ({opp}) rai sai. Galoi shakawn as '[b1 c3]' (kaw na → kaw hting) rai sai. Hpang de ahte shakawn hpaw shingkrai langai hpaw shingkrai hpang de ahte kaw shingkrai.
Hpang de ahte hpaw shingkrai {score_per_capture} kaw lu rai sai. Hpang de ahte kaw shingkrai {max_moves} kaw hting rai sai, shi hpang de ahte hpaw shingkrai kaw na n re kaw shingkrai hpang de ahte hpaw shingkrai n re kaw hting rai sai. Kaw lu shingkrai hpang de ahte hpaw shingkrai shingkrai.
